column3: Supine bicycle crunch; no cardio machine.
Adduction toward midline against cable, not abduction.
Supporting full-range curl reference. Render seven lower-half, seven upper-half and seven full-range concept phases; a short preview cannot show all 21 repetitions.
Standing cable chest fly family; keep elbows slightly bent and equipment fixed.
Supporting cable upright-row setup; use rope attachment instead of straight bar.
Representative cable rotational pattern; check exact intended twist variant.
Supporting vertical knee-raise mechanics; use forearm-supported captain chair.
Use pronated grip and retain chest support.
Supporting rear-delt fly; render standing bent-over stance for this broad entry, no bench seat.
Supporting curl form. Preview lower-half, upper-half and full-range phases; not all 21 repetitions.
Representative bench-supported one-arm dumbbell row for broad catalog entry.
Maintain palms-up supinated grip.
Supporting lunge poses; render forward stepping gait, not static split squat.
Supporting curl form. Preview lower-half, upper-half and full-range phases, not 21 full repetitions.
Supporting reverse curl mechanics; substitute EZ bar with pronated grip.
Supporting seated concentration curl; use an EZ bar.
Supporting preacher curl; use an EZ bar and fixed upper-arm support.
Representative flat-bench leg raise; no swinging or bent-knee crunch substitution.
Representative standing overhead barbell French press; broad record needs variant review.
Use one dumbbell held at chest rather than kettlebell if reference uses kettlebell.
Supporting plate-loaded decline press family; exact manufacturer linkage not established.
Supporting plate-loaded incline press family; exact brand linkage needs review.
Supporting plate-loaded chest press family; exact brand linkage needs review.
Representative overhand lat pulldown for broad entry.
Representative dumbbell overhead extension; broad entry lacks exact equipment setup.
Supporting preacher curl mechanics; use EZ bar.
Maintain overhand pronated grip.
Supporting barbell pullover; use EZ bar.
Supporting backward lunge gait; no dumbbells if catalog entry is bodyweight.
Supporting vertical knee/hip raise; retain Roman chair forearm supports.
Representative treadmill gait; broad running entry needs setting review.
Supporting neutral-grip dumbbell curl mechanics; render seated upright on bench.
Keep only one working arm; nonworking hand remains at side.
Supporting sissy squat mechanics; omit added weight for bodyweight entry.
Supporting guided shrug geometry; render bar IN FRONT of thighs for generic Smith shrug.
Stationary split stance; feet stay planted, no walking step.
Maintain palms-up supinated grip.
Representative cable pressdown; broad imported entry requires variant review.
Representative dumbbell overhead triceps extension for broad imported entry.
Supporting upright-row mechanics; use EZ bar.
Use two dumbbells and a box/bench of appropriate height; controlled touch rather than sitting/rocking.
Rear foot elevated on bench. Representative dumbbell version of broad Bulgarian split-squat entry.
Supporting rear-foot-elevated squat poses; OMIT dumbbells, keep bodyweight only.
Standing straight-arm cable pulldown/pullover pattern; shoulder extension with elbows almost straight.
Representative straight-arm cable shoulder-extension pattern.
Supporting bent-over elbow-extension body mechanics only. REPLACE dumbbell with low-pulley cable handle, anchor behind/in front to oppose backward hand movement; elbow fixed beside torso.
Supporting elbow-extension pose only. Use a taut low-pulley cable instead of dumbbell; no overhead extension.
Representative standing calf machine, shoulders under fixed lever pads; ankles move while forefeet planted.
Representative chest-supported dumbbell row for broad entry; keep chest against incline bench.
Supporting supine leg-raise mechanics. Use a declined bench with head higher than feet, grip support above head; no sit-up.
Supporting push-up mechanics only. Place hands close beneath sternum, index fingers/thumbs form diamond; feet remain planted.
Catalog primary targets are deltoids: render seated dumbbell SHOULDER press, not bench press.
Supporting bench-supported hip extension. Remove barbell; one dumbbell held securely on pelvis; single planted working foot, opposite leg lifted.
Rise with both feet, shift support to one foot for slower controlled lowering; depict clear asymmetric eccentric phase and stable hand support.
Supporting cable lateral-raise setup. One hand grips fixed upright, body leans away, working hand raises low cable laterally; keep lean angle fixed.
Supporting one-arm dumbbell lateral raise. Other hand grips fixed post and body leans away throughout.
Supporting face-pull arm/scapular path. Replace cable with elastic band anchored at face height, pull ends toward temples, elbows high.
Supporting supine bridge mechanics; OMIT barbell and weight, bodyweight only, shoulders on floor.
Supporting bridge pose; OMIT barbell and all added weight, shoulders on floor.
Supporting supine bridge. Hold hips up, alternate lifting each foot a small distance without pelvis dropping; no repeated full hip thrusts.
Chest-supported dumbbell row on incline bench; maintain chest support and controlled scapular motion.
Supporting chest-supported row setup. Allow controlled scapular protraction/retraction and row elbows out for upper-back emphasis; torso stays supported.
Equipment reference only: stand inside hex bar with arms straight and torso upright, SHRUG shoulders without deadlifting or bending elbows.

Supporting anchored-band apparatus only. Render HIP ABDUCTION: band around outside working ankle, anchor across body on opposite side so outward leg movement stretches band; knee straight, pelvis fixed.
Supporting bench-supported hip-thrust setup; OMIT barbell and weights, bodyweight only.
Supporting incline press mechanics. Use a clearly WIDE grip, symmetrical hands beyond shoulder width; no neck-level lowering.
Supporting push-up mechanics. Hands on elevated fixed bench, feet on floor, torso straight; not decline push-up.
Bodyweight inclined row under fixed bar; heels planted and body straight.
Supporting swing mechanics only; use TWO hands on ONE kettlebell, hip hinge drives bell to about chest height, no arm curl or overhead snatch.
Supporting vertical pulling mechanics. Kneel on floor, elastic band anchored overhead, pull ends toward upper chest; no machine seat or cable tower.
Supporting suspended rollout. Knees planted on floor; hands hold two rings suspended from fixed overhead straps; extend hips/shoulders and return, no rolling wheel.
Kneeling rope cable pullover/prayer: hips hinged slightly, almost straight elbows, draw upper arms down toward thighs while torso stays stable.
Seated dumbbell overhead press with elbows laterally oriented and back supported.
Representative prone lying machine leg curl for broad knee-flexion entry.
Supporting bench press mechanics; BOTH legs raised off floor with knees bent, hips stay on bench, no leg drive.
Supporting prone plank. Elbows positioned noticeably ahead of shoulders, legs straight, hold neutral trunk without sagging; sustained isometric.
Set bench to LOW incline about 15–30 degrees, not steep shoulder-press angle.
Set bench to LOW incline about 15–30 degrees.
Supporting plate-loaded incline press family; use low-incline bench/backrest, exact manufacturer geometry not established.
Cable chest fly from LOW pulleys, hands sweep upward and inward toward upper chest; no high-to-low crossover.
Representative bodyweight lunge; no added weights. Show controlled forward step and return/gait.
Both arms row together, chest stays against machine support pad; fixed frame and lever pivots.
Representative seated triceps dip/press machine, hands press handles down with pelvis/torso fixed.
Supporting neck extension setup. Small controlled cervical range, head supported appropriately; approximate neck-muscle patch only.
Supporting supine cervical flexion, small controlled range; head/neck alignment and pad placement need review.
Representative gentle isometric side-neck resistance with hand, no large neck circles or rapid head tilts.
Supporting dip setup. Demonstrate SLOW LOWERING only; assisted step-up/reset between descents, not reversed concentric.
Supporting pull-up setup. Begin chin over bar using a small step, SLOW LOWERING then assisted reset; no kipping.
Representative close neutral-grip pull-up with parallel palms, fixed handles.
Representative neutral close-grip pulldown with parallel handles, not pronated wide grip.
Supporting knee-flexion lowering mechanics; kneel on floor with ankles securely anchored, elastic band anchored behind/above supports torso during forward lean.
Kneel on padded floor with ankles anchored, trunk/hips straight, lower forward from knees; optional hand-assisted reset, no machine seated curl.
Replace cable with elastic band anchored at sternum height to the side; press hands forward resisting torso rotation.
Representative standing cable chest fly, palms sweep toward midline at chest height, elbows slightly bent.
Supporting rowing mechanics. Trunk near horizontal, bar begins and returns to FLOOR on each rep; no continuously hanging row.
Pendlay row: trunk near horizontal and bar resets on floor EACH repetition.
Supporting seated hip-abduction mechanism; render plate-loaded lever resistance, not selectorized stack. Exact manufacturer linkage needs review.
Supporting push-up mechanics. Hands near waist, shoulders lean forward past wrists, elbows bend under control; toes support feet.
Supporting assisted vertical pull. Use UNDERHAND grip, band loop supporting knee, no pronated pull-up.
Supporting prone reverse hyper. Omit external load, pelvis supported on bench and legs extend behind under control, torso remains fixed.
Hands hold two rings on fixed overhead straps, toes support feet; extend shoulders/trunk as rings travel forward and return, no wheel or kneeling.
Supporting hip-hinge mechanics; OMIT barbell/weights, bodyweight hinge with hands crossed on chest.
Supporting Romanian hinge. Replace barbell with two dumbbells held beside/front of thighs; soft knees, no floor reset or deep conventional squat.
Supporting squat mechanics only. Use safety squat bar with padded yoke, cambered ends and forward handles; preserve rigid bar geometry, no conventional straight bar.
Chest supported on elevated FLAT bench, barbell rows underneath; not incline row. Bar/bench clearances need review.
Supporting chest-supported row pose. Use elevated FLAT bench and two dumbbells, chest/pelvis fixed; not incline bench.
Supporting face-pull mechanics. Sit upright on fixed bench, cable anchored at face height, pull rope ends toward temples.
Use clearly WIDE pronated handle, elbows row out laterally; fixed seated cable row setup.
Supporting Smith shrug apparatus. Put bar in FRONT of thighs for generic Smith shrug; elbows straight and only scapula elevates.
Representative standing cable lateral trunk-flexion pattern; broad imported side-crunch entry requires exact variant review.
Side-lying straight-leg hip abduction, no resistance bands or machine.
Sustained side plank on one forearm and stacked feet, pelvis held up; no repeated hip drops.
Sustained side plank hold, not repeated side-bridge reps.
One independent lever rows while other hand stays still; torso/chest supported.
Supporting single-leg hinge mechanics; OMIT kettlebell/weights, keep standing knee softly bent and hips level.
Supporting single-leg hinge. Replace kettlebell with one dumbbell; keep pelvis level and nonstance leg extends behind.
Single-leg supine bridge with NONWORKING leg straight, shoulders on floor.
Supporting bench hip-thrust setup. OMIT barbell, one working foot planted and other leg lifted; shoulders stay on bench.
Only one working arm curls, upper arm stays on support; other side stationary.
Representative one-arm cable extension using rope end; elbow fixed, no shoulder swing.
One working arm on machine pad, other side still; preserve machine pivot.
Representative prone machine curl with ONE working leg; other leg straight/still.
Prone machine curl with ONE working leg, pelvis fixed.
Supporting leg-press sled geometry. Only ONE foot on platform, other foot clear; knees track toes and pelvis remains on seat.
One-foot leg press, other leg does not contribute; preserve sled rails and plate angle.
Ankle plantarflexion/toe press on leg press, NOT knee-extension leg press. Slow controlled eccentric heel lowering, forefeet remain planted.
Supporting guided bar row. Trunk near horizontal, pause/reset bar low on every repetition; no continuous suspended rows.
Supporting standing cable trunk flexion. Add controlled lateral flexion for oblique emphasis, pelvis fixed; exact broad variant needs review.
Supporting step-up body mechanics; OMIT dumbbells, step onto fixed box, do not jump.
Straight-arm parallel-bar SUPPORT HOLD, body suspended and shoulders depressed; no elbow bending or dip reps.
Representative lying band elbow extension; preserve bench support and rear anchor. Broad imported variant needs review.
Supine V-up/jackknife, arms and straight legs rise together then controlled lowering; no seated static V hold.
More upright bodyweight row under fixed bar, heels remain planted; not standing loaded upright row.
Supporting push-up mechanics. Hands on vertical wall at chest height, feet on floor, body straight; not floor push-up.
Add visible securely attached dip belt and modest plate hanging beneath pelvis. Keep support handles fixed; no bodyweight-only substitution.
Add securely attached dip belt and modest plate hanging below pelvis. No swinging, fixed overhead hand positions.
Bodyweight inverted row with WIDE pronated grip and elbows out, heels planted.

Supporting cable curl posture only. Use a low pulley BEHIND the body: stand facing away, working upper arm slightly behind torso, palm forward. Curl by bending elbow without swinging shoulder; cable remains attached to hand and rear low pulley. Not a cable wrist curl.

Supporting hip-hinged row posture only. Replace the free barbell with a straight handle attached to a low cable IN FRONT of the person. No free barbell plates. Keep torso hinged and stationary, draw handle toward lower abdomen, return under control; cable must stay taut to fixed low pulley.

Supporting standing curl posture only. Replace dumbbells with elastic band handles; band midpoint anchored under both planted feet. Elbows remain by torso, curl palms upward, lower under control; elastic connections must stay attached and stretch as hands rise.

Supporting seated concentration curl pose only. Replace dumbbell with low pulley handle, cable coming from in front. Working elbow braced against inner thigh, torso and upper arm remain stable while elbow bends and returns. No dumbbell or free weight in hand.

Supporting standing cable rotation geometry only. Replace cable tower with resistance band attached to a fixed lateral anchor at chest height. Start with arms extended, rotate torso smoothly away from anchor and back, maintain planted feet and continuous elastic connection. No additional chest press in this version.

Supporting ordinary pushup posture only. Place hands on two identical LOW stable blocks so chest can descend slightly below hand height within comfortable range. Keep head-trunk-hips aligned, forefeet planted on floor; bend elbows to lower and extend to return. Blocks must remain stationary throughout.

Supporting prone leg curl joint positions only. Use a plain flat bench, no curl-machine lever. Hold ONE small dumbbell securely between the feet, curl knees while thighs and pelvis stay supported on bench, lower without dropping weight. Dumbbell must stay between feet throughout.

Supporting two-hand overhead triceps extension posture only. Replace dumbbell with ONE kettlebell held by horns with both hands. Follow detailed catalog instructions; keep upper arms near head, lower bell behind head by elbow flexion and extend elbows overhead. No shoulder press or halo circle.

Supporting band placement and bent-knee stance only. Perform short SIDEWAYS steps, not forward/backward monster walks. One loop above knees; keep slight squat and continuous band tension. Two controlled lateral steps, trailing foot follows without feet touching. Maintain same fixed camera, never mirror person to change direction.

Supporting prone supported reverse hyper posture only. Use band resistance instead of plate-loaded pendulum: torso supported, hips at bench edge, loop secured to fixed bench base and around ankles. Raise both legs via hip extension toward torso line and lower under control, no lumbar hyperextension or moving machine carriage.

Supporting floor hamstring slide reference. Demonstrate bilateral supine sliding leg curl with both heels on sliders, hips elevated and shoulders on floor: pull heels toward hips by bending knees, then extend knees under control while preserving a comfortable hip position. Source single-leg example differs; no standing or prone machine curl.

Supporting standing lateral leg raise posture only. Add ankle cuff attached to LOW pulley at opposite side; working leg moves away from anchor laterally against taut cable. Hold upright support, pelvis remains level, return controlled without ballistic swinging or crossing far past standing leg. No seated abductor machine.

Supporting seated lever/preacher curl geometry only. Use two independent NEUTRAL vertical handles with palms facing inward, thumbs up, wrists neutral throughout. Upper arms stay supported on pads as elbows bend and extend. Not underhand/supinated curl, not dumbbell curls. Representative neutral-grip machine version; exact manufacturer absent from catalog and human/handle contact needs review.
